ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/cream) on distal lobes and 35% low-intensity pixels (black) centered around the longitudinal axis and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity pigmentation forms a wide 'Y' shape extending from the base; distal lobes are primarily high-intensity with clusters of low-intensity speckling (mottling) along the interior margins and trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees; bounding box depth approximately 1/5th of total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks; distinct irregularities and small nicks visible on the distal segments of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetry with a convex curve from the notch, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of high-contrast dark pixels observed on the distal right tip and scattered along the lower boundary of the left lobe's high-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-tan pixel shift across high-intensity regions, consistent with biological film/diatom accumulation; several small notches along the trailing edge topography.
